@graph.name: Ginger Chicken Noodle Soup
@graph.description: A clear, gingery broth with poached chicken, greens and noodles. Comforting when you're under the weather.

recipeInstructions.name: Infuse
recipeInstructions.text: Bring the stock, ginger and garlic to a simmer in a large pan and cook for 10 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Poach
recipeInstructions.text: Add the chicken breasts and poach gently for 15–18 minutes until cooked through. Lift out and shred with two forks.

recipeInstructions.name: Finish
recipeInstructions.text: Season the broth with soy sauce, add the noodles and pak choi and cook for 4 minutes. Return the chicken, then ladle into bowls and top with spring onions and chilli.
